original.target_description: Bryan et al. (2011), Experiment 3: noun-versus-verb wording effect on official-record voter turnout in the 2009 New Jersey gubernatorial election, without the premanipulation voting-probability covariate.

n.sample_role: Participants matched in official New Jersey voter turnout records and retained in the critical condition-effect analysis.
